Core Character Profile

Level 8 is the canonical starting point. XP determines total level; every earned or lost level opens an allocation popup for the primary or secondary class.

Canonical Classes, Deities, Bounty Ichor, and Covenant

✦

Each of the twenty-two classes retains exactly one canonical deity. Class practices, hazards, Bounty triggers, deity edicts, anathemas, Resonance, and Divine Claim are mechanical character data—not flavor.

Character Data Input

Names and character details are entered manually, imported from a saved JSON file, or sent in from Character Creator / linked creator pages. This sheet does not generate names.

Universal Eight-Axis Covenant Alignment

✦

All eight axes use 0–3000 in 250-point steps. The original four profile axes still select one of the canonical 81 names; Mercy, Transformation, Autonomy, and Restraint create the expression line. Releasing a slider opens an explanation popup and all derived fields autofill.
